subject.title: fix(hooks): bound hook workspace manifest and HOOK.md reads

question: Should workspace hook `package.json` and `HOOK.md` metadata be limited to 1 MiB with warn-and-skip behavior, accepting that larger existing hooks stop loading after upgrade?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically sound, but the fixed threshold and failure behavior define a security-versus-compatibility contract that code review cannot select on maintainer intent alone.

options.title: Accept 1 MiB warn-and-skip
options.body: Adopt the tested fixed ceiling consistently with install-time hook hardening and accept the narrow upgrade break for oversized metadata.

options.title: Choose a larger fixed ceiling
options.body: Raise and document the constant before merge if maintainers want more compatibility headroom without adding configuration surface.

options.title: Pause the behavior change
options.body: Do not merge until maintainers define a different bounded-read and operator-diagnostic contract.

recommendation.title: Accept 1 MiB warn-and-skip
recommendation.body: Adopt the tested fixed ceiling consistently with install-time hook hardening and accept the narrow upgrade break for oversized metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work connects this person to both the hooks area and core boundary infrastructure relevant to the threshold decision.
